answer: An AI-agent economy resists Sybil attacks using memory-bound latency proofs. To participate, every node, from a lightweight sparrow client to a falcon relay, must solve serialized pointer-chasing puzzles within tight latency windows. This forces an attacker to dedicate scarce memory bus bandwidth and sustained power per identity, preventing a costless ripple of forged personas on shared hardware. However, network jitter and geographic latency can unfairly disqualify honest peripheral nodes.
